notes.title: Patch 2.0 Notes
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Redesigned locations for easier navigation.  
[*] Added a countdown timer before Star's dance sequence.  
[*] Translated gameplay-relevant posters.  
[*] Added and reworked several sound effects.  
[*] Adjusted Tidey's escape location for a smoother experience.  
[*] Introduced additional interactive elements in Lumina's maze.  
[*] Reduced overall game size on disk.  
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Notes
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Adjustments:[/b]  

[list]  
[*] Adjusted the balance of Tidey and Star AI.  
[*] Fixed a bug with items being saved when starting a new game.  
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.  
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Notes
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]  

[list]  
[*] Added 7 interactive radio to uncover more about the universe's lore.  
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Notes
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Adjustments:[/b]  

[list]  
[*] Adjusted the balance of Dancer, making it easier to hit the correct keys.  
[*] Simplified the Clawmachine for a smoother experience.  
[*] Reworked Lumina's maze: her location is now visually indicated.  
[*] Simplified progression through Lumina's maze.  
[*] Adjusted Lumina's balance during the boss fight.  
[*] Reduced Tidey's chase speed.  
[/list]  

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]  

[list]  
[*] Fixed several minor bugs that did not affect gameplay.  
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Notes
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Adjustments:[/b]  
  
[list]  
[*] Reduced Lumina's chase speed.  
[*] Reduced Star's chase speed.  
[*] Simplified the Star challenge.  
[*] Lumina in the maze now moves slower.  
[/list]
